description: This plot illustrates a comparison between "Initial Accuracy" and "Final Accuracy" across varying frequencies. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with numeric tick marks placed at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines, both featuring vertical error bars at each data point. The "Initial Accuracy" line is represented by a solid green line with square markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.34 at an x-value of 1, rises to a local peak of roughly 0.49 at x=5, declines to about 0.30 at x=7, and reaches its highest point of approximately 0.52 at x=13 before ending at roughly 0.41 at x=19. The "Final Accuracy" line is depicted as a dashed blue line with circular markers. It starts at approximately 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to roughly 0.72 at x=7, and reaches its maximum value of approximately 0.92 at x=9. It then declines to a low of about 0.68 at x=13, rises again to roughly 0.90 at x=15, dips slightly to 0.82 at x=17, and concludes at approximately 0.90 at x=19.
